node_selector_rule: selector must match a declared node role from node-graph.contract.json; unknown node or role is rejected; runtime never iterates unknown nodes

effect_rule.read_only: writes must be empty; plugin may only read current-node data and information
effect_rule.control_only: writes must be control or information axis resources; normal payload writes forbidden
effect_rule.semantic: may write current-node data and typed control resources; may not write other node data
effect_rule.diagnostic_only: writes must be empty; debug/snapshot/observer must not change business output or control flow

resource_rule: reads and writes must resolve against the node allowed resource registry; unknown resource or unauthorized write is rejected
selection_group_rule: selection_group selects exactly one active variant; group-external plugins keep executing; zero or multiple active variants are rejected
failure_rule: plugin failure enters typed error intake; silent strip, fallback, and skip-continue are forbidden
ordering_rule: compile order = phase fixed partial order -> before/after DAG -> order -> stable identity; same phase and order without declared relation is a tie and rejected; dependency cycle rejected
hash_rule: contract_hash = sha256 of canonical contract JSON; canonical JSON is byte-stable with sorted keys and fixed separators
service_rule: inject is a Service dependency, not a payload field; a plugin can only inject services provided inside its own node container
